meta.selection: The smaller 2020–2025 modality archive defines membership. Specified venues only; corrected publication identity removes exact duplicates; withdrawn and wearable-only studies are excluded. Distinct conference/journal publications are separate.
meta.benchmarkPolicy: Representative results corresponding to Table III and Figure 5, not an exhaustive leaderboard. Ranking is within the selected dataset, protocol, metric and training source. CCGR-Mini selects the highest R1 per listed configuration among imported sources; accompanying metrics remain from the same record. Result sources are independent of the literature-statistics venue list. Cross-domain rankings and matrices use one reporting source at a time. CASIA-B and CASIA-B* retain their source labels. R1 preserves a source-reported overall score; missing aggregates are not inferred from condition means.
meta.datasetPolicy: One use per publication and dataset; co-usage is inclusive (other datasets may also occur). Missing dataset or modality information is not counted as a use.
meta.modalityPolicy: Recorded inputs, including training auxiliaries; multiple recorded modalities do not necessarily imply test-time fusion. Skeleton and Pose preserve the archive labels.
catalogueNotes: Table II resource descriptions are transcribed from the manuscript; reference year may postdate collection.
BRIAR BGC1–4: 1,173 fully collected subjects + 587 indoor-image-only distractors.
MMGait: modality-specific sequences, not independent walks.
BarbieGait: synthetic sequences from 521 source identities.
Table II usage is the revised fixed-corpus value. Filtered usage applies the selected year and venue; OU-ISIR resource usage follows records labeled OU-LP.
